ambiguities.description: The relationship between 'Shipment contains Product' and 'Shipment-Product has Quantity' requires clarification. The transcript states that shipments contain products and each product appears in a specific quantity. This could be modeled as either: (1) a ternary fact type 'Shipment-Product has Quantity' (current model), or (2) two separate binary fact types where 'Shipment contains Product' is independent. The current ternary model is preferred to enforce the business rule that each shipment-product pair has exactly one quantity line.
